answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one glacier weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The nadir report makes public the merge explicitly at each willow. Because of that, someone who spins up 142 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 127 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4817 identities would post 1333 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
